declarations.name: n04_increment_sample_E0_power_bound
declarations.full_header:
private theorem n04_increment_sample_E0_power_bound
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hRef : IsAccumulatingProfile D)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    ∃ K Q : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ 0 ≤ Q ∧ ∀ j,
      T.E0 (T.sample j) ^ R ≤ K * radialE (D.cellIndex j) ^ Q

declarations.name: N01Properties.coefficientIncrement_parameterSpatialTower_parameterJet
declarations.full_header:
theorem N01Properties.coefficientIncrement_parameterSpatialTower_parameterJet
    (m j : ℕ) (hcell : Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells j)
    (i : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (x : StateDirections S × ℝ)
    (hx : x ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε) (v : Fin n → StateDirections S × ℝ)
    {y : PolarPoint} (hy : y ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :
    hN.componentCoefficientScalarJet m j hcell i n x v y =
      (hN.coefficientIncrement_parameterSpatialTower hS hT m j hcell i).D
        n (x, y) (fun k => (v k, 0))

declarations.name: N01Properties.coefficientIncrement_joint_unit_bound
declarations.full_header:
theorem N01Properties.coefficientIncrement_joint_unit_bound (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ A Q : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ 0 ≤ Q ∧
      ∀ (m j : ℕ) (hcell : Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells j) (i : Fin 3),
      ∀ x ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε,
      ∀ y ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ),
      ∀ v : Fin n → (StateDirections S × ℝ) × PolarPoint,
      (∀ k, pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading base (v k).1 + ‖(v k).2‖ ≤ 1) →
      |(hN.coefficientIncrement_parameterSpatialTower hS hT m j hcell i).D n (x, y) v| ≤
        A * T.H (T.sample j) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * radialE (D.cellIndex j) ^ Q *
          (1 + pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading (n + loss) x +
            ∑ k, pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading (n + loss) (v k).1)

declarations.name: N01Properties.coefficientIncrement_normalized_joint_growth
declarations.full_header:
theorem N01Properties.coefficientIncrement_normalized_joint_growth
    (j : ℕ → ℕ) (hcell : ∀ m, Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells (j m))
    (i : Fin 3) :
    UniformWeightedJointGrowth (pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading)
      (fun m => radialE (D.cellIndex (j m)))
      (fun m => smoothDirectionsScalarPostcompose
        (hN.coefficientIncrement_parameterSpatialTower hS hT m (j m) (hcell m) i)
        ((T.H (T.sample (j m)) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ))⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))
      base loss

actual_providers.read_scope: Full actual source read; pure and continuous map APIs selected explicitly

purpose: Estimate the existing genuine coefficient increment joint tower with its actual sample H^(3/4) gain, then deterministically normalize that SAME tower by the inverse scalar. No final target estimate is an input.

actual_objects.D_T_S_C: The input N01 data are never reconstructed.
actual_objects.J: hN.coefficientIncrement_parameterSpatialTower hS hT m j hcell i, literally
actual_objects.sample: T.sample j where Ioo(C.left m)(C.right m) subset D.cells j; j is universally quantified and not replaced by C.cell or m.
actual_objects.normalized_J: smoothDirectionsScalarPostcompose J ((T.H(T.sample j)^(3/4))^(-1) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
actual_objects.low_base: The literal input base, before every total joint order n.
actual_objects.loss: The literal input loss. All high terms use n+loss.
actual_objects.domain: sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε × (Ioo(C.left m)(C.right m) × univ). No discriminant/lower/buffer premise.

proof_audit: Pure-parameter slots of the joint J equal the existing sector coefficient jets through pointTower_eq_jointJet; no new choice of tower.
Raw componentCoefficientScalarJet_mixed_bound is transported on the genuine open component using mixedDerivative_congr_on_open.

Finite prefix k<=n has mixed cap n. Actual sample E0 powers are bounded by powers of the SAME radialE index using global endpoint models and the one-sided material shift. H is not involved in this comparison.
Finite constants/exponents are summed only after W>=1 is known. The number of terms can affect constants, not base/loss.
The mixed-to-joint C parameter is A*H_j*W_j^Q. Its separate affine H parameter is 1+p(n+loss)x. All three directional pieces therefore retain H_j.
The scalar postcompose applies H_j^(-1) to every layer, including n=0. Exact inverse cancellation retains the same constants and base/loss in UniformWeightedJointGrowth.
